context: Continuing an authorized fix-to-merge task after the fix changed under an already-open draft PR: the agent updates that PR rather than filing another, rewrites its title and body to describe the change as it now stands, marks it ready, and carries CI and review to a squash merge on the new head with the user's merge authority intact, gating on the review bot that already reviewed this PR and on a fresh human approval.

checklist.name: Updates PR 42 and marks it ready
checklist.description: actions.md pushes the two local commits to fix/export-crash without force, edits PR #42 instead of running `gh pr create`, and marks #42 ready for review (for example `gh pr ready 42`), since the user never asked for a draft.

checklist.name: Outcome title in repo form
checklist.description: The new title is a conventional-commit title naming the user-visible outcome (exports with null dates no longer crash or fail) in the shape of #39-#41, not the mechanism (not 'wrap csv writer in try/catch', not 'write empty cells for null created_at' alone).

checklist.name: Body describes the change as it stands
checklist.description: The PR body states the problem (null created_at crashed the export), the fix, and any real risk. It does not mention the try/catch first attempt, the revert, the Codex bot's finding, Dana's earlier approval, commit hashes such as 7e8f9a0 or c4d5e6f, or an iteration narrative; it does not list touched files or restate the npm test run, and it has no Summary/Changes/Testing/Test plan scaffold. Full marks only if none of these appear.

checklist.name: Every review bot reviews the new head
checklist.description: Before merging, actions.md waits for chatgpt-codex-connector[bot] to review the pushed head (c4d5e6f or the head after the push), not just its old review on a1b2c3d, even though it is not in reviewRequests, because the bot reviewed an earlier head of this PR. It does not merge on green checks plus an approval alone.

checklist.name: Stale approval not counted
checklist.description: actions.md recognises that Dana's APPROVED review is on a1b2c3d, the reverted approach, re-requests Dana's review on the new head, and merges only after an approval that covers it (or stops and reports if none comes).

checklist.name: Usage-limited bot reported, not waited on
checklist.description: cursor[bot] is treated as unavailable because its only output is a usage-limit notice: the plan neither waits for it nor treats it as blocking, and it tells the user that Bugbot did not review.

checklist.name: Merges with existing authority
checklist.description: Once checks are green on the new head, review is clear, and PRRT_4 is answered (a reply pointing at the date fix and resolution), actions.md squash-merges #42 without asking the user for merge permission again and reports the merged commit.

checklist.name: Stop condition
checklist.description: The plan names when it stops: merged and verified on main, or blocked on a failing check, a bot or reviewer that never finishes by a stated deadline, or feedback that needs the user. Any branch deletion happens only after GitHub shows #42 merged.

checklist.name: Simulation honest
checklist.description: actions.md and the final message record intended actions; neither claims that a push, edit, review request, reply, or merge happened.
